ocmulgee.method: 800 m LiDAR crop: Great Temple Mound at (-83.6086,32.8369), round mound at the Wikidata point (-83.6051,32.8411)
ocmulgee.note: the catalogue point was 400 m E of the Great Temple Mound; centre set between the two

fort-toulouse-mound.note: the bastioned square fort (Fort Toulouse / Fort Jackson) at the confluence; the Woodland mound is ~400 m NW; quads print 'Fort' and 'Indian Mound'

crystal-river.note: ring-shaped and round mounds on the north bank at the river mouth, where both 1954 quads print 'Indian Mound'; the catalogue point was marsh and canals

angel-mounds.method: 800 m LiDAR crop at the Wikidata point
angel-mounds.note: the large Mound A (a rectangle ~50 x 70 m) inside the D-shaped palisade line on the Ohio terrace; the catalogue point was the Ohio River levee

marksville.method: 800 m LiDAR crop at the Wikidata point
marksville.note: the great D-shaped embankment arc with several round mounds inside it, beside the Marksville town grid

madira-bickel.method: 600 m LiDAR crop at the Wikidata point
madira-bickel.note: a platform mound (~36 m) with a notch at the Wikidata point; the catalogue point was a freeway interchange 2 km away

maumbury-rings.method: 500 m LiDAR crop at the catalogue point
maumbury-rings.note: the horseshoe-shaped Maumbury Rings (~85 m) in Dorchester ~230 m W / 140 m S of the crop centre, i.e. at the catalogue point

mount-pleasant-henge.note: the oval henge enclosure (~360 x 175 m) at the point

west-kennet-long-barrow.note: the bright elongated barrow (~100 x 25 m) at the point

windmill-hill-avebury.note: the causewayed enclosure's concentric ditches with ring-ditched barrows

burcht-van-leiden.note: the circular Burcht motte with its ring wall, ~40 m W of the point

kong-asgers-hoj.note: a round mound (~20 m) with a halo exactly at the point in a field

vilnius-gediminas-hill.note: the hill of Gediminas Tower with the castle ruins, ramparts and moat

skara-brae.note: the Bay of Skaill shore with a faint grassy settlement patch ~50 m N of the point; the stone houses are under turf

brodgar.note: duplicate of ring-of-brodgar (early test build: the ring ~100 m N of its centre is the Ring of Brodgar)

wyalusing-mounds.note: coordinate or site not confirmed: forested bluff: a cluster of short curved bars (~35 m) 60 m SW of the catalogue point in the 1 m ground grid could be linear mounds but has canopy-noise edges; the rest is gullies and a picnic loop road: not conclusive

spiro-mounds.note: 1 m ground grid (3DEP point cloud) at the best-known coordinate: nothing identifiable as the earthwork; the catalogue coordinate is county-level (from memory) (crop at 35.2517,-94.5694: a town, a few ring-shaped features and a patch of regular bumps, none conclusive)
